projects.name: QueueUp - Ticket management dashboard
projects.description: A responsive SaaS prototype modeling a complete business workflow—from a conversion-focused landing page to a secure, data-driven dashboard with full ticket management capabilities.

choices.title: Robust Data Integrity
choices.description: Implemented Zod schemas for strict form validation, ensuring error-free data submission.

choices.title: UX/UI Design
choices.description: Built a clean, accessible layout with TailwindCSS, featuring toast notifications and status-based filtering.

choices.title: Full-Stack Prototyping
choices.description: Leveraged AI to generate a functional backend with JWT mock authentication, allowing for a focus on production-grade frontend architecture and API consumption.

projects.name: Multilingual Translation Interface
projects.description: A functional language converter supporting English, French, and Spanish with bidirectional swapping logic.

choices.title: Performance Optimization
choices.description: Implemented input debouncing to manage real-time translation requests, significantly reducing API overhead and preventing rate-limiting during rapid typing.

choices.title: Native Browser Integration
choices.description: Leveraged the Web Speech API for text-to-speech synthesis (accessibility) and the Clipboard API for seamless user copying.

choices.title: Asynchronous UX
choices.description: Implemented dedicated loading states to maintain UI responsiveness and provide visual feedback during data fetching/translation processing.

projects.name: Responsive Bank Landing Page
projects.description: A responsive banking landing page built with React and Tailwind CSS, focused on adaptive navigation behavior, clean component architecture, and mobile-first responsiveness.

choices.title: Component-Driven Architecture
choices.description: Structured the UI into reusable, isolated React components (Navbar, Hero, Features, CTA) to improve readability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

choices.title: Custom Responsive Logic
choices.description: Abstracted viewport and scroll behavior into custom hooks (useIsMobile and useScrolled) to manage navbar responsiveness and sticky behavior without cluttering component logic.

choices.title: Mobile-First Responsiveness
choices.description: Used Tailwind’s utility-first approach to design mobile-first layouts, progressively enhancing the UI for larger screens while maintaining consistent spacing and hierarchy.

projects.name: Browser Extension Manager UI
projects.description: A state-driven browser extension management interface built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, focusing on CRUD operations, UI state management, and theme toggling without the use of frameworks.

choices.title: Vanilla JavaScript State Management
choices.description: Implemented core CRUD operations (read, update, delete) using plain JavaScript, managing extension state changes and UI updates without relying on external libraries or frameworks.

choices.title: Toggle-Based Enable/Disable Logic
choices.description: Integrated a toggle-based interaction to control extension activation state, ensuring UI feedback stays in sync with underlying data changes.

choices.title: Theme Persistence
choices.description: Added light and dark theme support with persistent user preference handling to maintain a consistent experience across sessions.
